verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents Scheduling Links that share 'you and your team's availability, allowing others to book time across one, or many, calendars' (reclaim-docs-49). That is its own multi-host booking capability. The evidence does not say these links work in a collective mode that shows only slots where every required host is free, as opposed to round-robin or any-host availability, and there is no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: explicit documentation of collective/all-hosts-required availability logic, required vs optional host configuration, independent or hands-on confirmation of team booking links.
